name: 나무돌이

casual.scene: At a clear mountain-river resort beside a shallow stone bathing pool at sunset, body side-on and face turned toward viewer, squeezing water from the end of her ponytail with one hand while the other rests separately on a dry rock. Head through knees and both complete hands visible; peach rim light.
casual.outfit: Lined forest-green two-piece athletic bikini with coral-red piping, secure broad straps and tiny leaf stud earrings. Bare arms, midriff and legs; modern resort swimwear.

casual.scene: In an empty sunlit dance practice studio at late morning, stepping through a light warm-up turn with both hands open beside her waist. Full head to shoes visible, warm wooden floor and diffuse skylight; no mirrors.
casual.outfit: Coral-red fitted racerback sports bra, dark-green high-waisted running shorts with curved hems, cream trainers and slim leaf pendant. Bare arms, midriff and legs; athletic contemporary clothing.

casual.scene: At a shaded campsite picnic counter at midday, arranging sliced fruit in an unmarked bamboo lunch box. One hand places a small berry while the other steadies a separate corner, complete forearms and hands inside crop; green canopy reflections.
casual.outfit: Ivory sleeveless wrap sundress with a secure coral inset and small green belt buckle, tiny leaf earrings. Bare shoulders and arms; soft cotton picnic clothing.

comparison_scope: Recent three plans and nine submitted casual prompts read; canonical faces visually inspected and compared with Treecko. New casual scenes changed location, activity, clothing silhouette and composition.
face_reason: Long leaf outlines and elongated agile body translated through species face-design into a long narrow face, defined chin and horizontal narrow eyes; actual face distinguished from Treecko.
ui_verification: All nine actual UI selections inspected and exact output lengths and FNV matched production prompts.
